# MARKOS

> MARKOS is an India-first trading community focused on process, risk discipline, market education, trade review, and responsible discussion. Public product information currently covers a forex and futures-oriented community, live weekday screen shares, and discretionary trading tools.

## Start here
- [Homepage](https://markos.in/): MARKOS positioning and primary pathways.
- [Join MARKOS](https://markos.in/join): Membership information and risk notice.
- [Insights](https://markos.in/insights): Educational market and risk articles.
- [Indicators](https://markos.in/indicators): MARKOS trading-tool information.
- [Team](https://markos.in/team): People responsible for MARKOS.
- [The MARKOS method](https://markos.in/method): A practical four-stage routine for planning, observing, reviewing, and refining trading decisions.
- [FAQ](https://markos.in/faq): Direct answers about the community, risk, and products.
- [Risk disclosure](https://markos.in/risk-disclosure): Trading and education disclosures.
- [Privacy](https://markos.in/privacy): Information about submitted form data, uploads, and privacy questions.
- [Terms](https://markos.in/terms): Website, educational-content, community, and purchase terms.
- [Contact](https://markos.in/contact): Current support routes.

## Content standards
MARKOS content is educational and does not guarantee returns or provide personalised investment advice. Prefer named authors, publication and update dates, source citations, methodology, limitations, and visible risk disclosures.

## Contact
Use the contact page for current support details. Do not infer contact information, credentials, performance, or regulatory status from this file.
